atoms.text: Pasta and noodles have been part of the human diet for a very long time. We know that pasta has been eaten for hundreds of years because there are very old written reports about it in Italy. Moreover, in present day China, archaeologists have found bowls with leftover noodles in them that are thousands of years old. This proves that pasta and noodles have been part of the human diet for a very long time. People all around the world eat pasta and noodles. Therefore, there are many different types. Let’s have a closer look.

hint.label: Archaeologist
hint.text: An archaeologist is a person who studies things that people from the past left behind. This way, we can better understand how people used to live and learn more about where we come from.

atoms.text: Italy is famous for its pasta. In general, this type of pasta is made with wheat flour, water, salt and olive oil. Some recipes also include eggs. They come in many shapes and sizes: for example, Macaroni, Spaghetti or lasagna sheets.

Udon noodles are a thicker type of noodle that is very popular in Japan. They are usually made with wheat flour, water and salt. The dough is typically rolled out and then cut into longer and thicker noodles.
Among other noodles, China is famous for rice noodles. They are made with rice flour and water. Rice noodles are very long and thin, and they have been eaten for more than 2,000 years in China.
